```{r Setup}
#| message: FALSE
#| echo: False

library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)
```


```{r Import}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

M6_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_id_01_qv_06_test.sas7bdat")
```

# Corriger données d'identité

```{r M6_A0 to M6_A2}

# Ajouter id_doublon
M6_A1 <- M6_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_prenom = replace_when(
      id_prenom,
      id_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

M6_A2 <- M6_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(M6_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(qv_type:id_age_cat_3))
```

# Renommer et réordonner

```{r}
add_qv <- M6_A2 %>% 
  select(all_of(starts_with("sa_")),
         all_of(starts_with("sc_")),
         all_of(starts_with("am_")),
         ad_besoin,
         ad_lien,
         ad_type,
         ad_lien_autre) %>% 
  colnames()

M6_B0 <- M6_A2 %>% 
  rename_with(~ paste0("qv_", .x), all_of(add_qv)) %>%
  rename("qv_commentaires" = "commentaires_qual",
         "qv_ad_act01" = "VAR11",
         "qv_ad_act02" = "VAR2",
         "qv_ad_act03" = "VAR3",
         "qv_ad_act04" = "VAR4",
         "qv_ad_act05" = "VAR5",
         "qv_ad_act06" = "VAR6",
         "qv_ad_act07" = "VAR7",
         "qv_ad_act08" = "VAR8",
         "qv_ad_act09" = "VAR9",
         "qv_ad_act10" = "VAR10",
         "qv_ad_act999" = "ad_activites_999",
         "qv_ad_act_autre" = "ad_activites_autre") %>% 
  
  # Mettre toutes les variables en ordre
  relocate(id_anonymat, id_doublon, id_keep, qv_date_creation,
           qv_sa_etat, qv_sa_mobilite, qv_sa_autonomie, qv_sa_activites,
           qv_sa_douleurs, qv_sa_anxiete, 
           qv_sa_compl, qv_sa_medic, qv_sa_antibio, qv_sa_kine, qv_sa_hospi, qv_sa_transp,
           qv_ad_besoin, qv_ad_act01, qv_ad_act02:qv_ad_act10, qv_ad_act999, qv_ad_act_autre,
           qv_ad_type, qv_ad_lien, qv_ad_lien_autre, 
           qv_sc_travailleur, qv_sc_difficultes, qv_sc_sport, qv_sc_spectacle, 
           qv_sc_vacances, qv_sc_contacts, qv_sc_heberger, qv_sc_aide_materielle,
           qv_am_regime, qv_am_regime_autre, qv_am_complement, 
           qv_am_type_1, qv_am_type_2, qv_am_type_999, qv_am_type_autre,
           qv_am_ald, qv_am_rac, qv_am_rac_montant, 
           qv_am_rac_pour_1:qv_am_rac_pour_autre, qv_commentaires, id_date_creation,
           id_centre1:id_sexe) %>% 
  
  # Retirer variable inutile
  select(-qv_sa_autre_precisez)
```

# Identifier absents

```{r}

vars_check <- M6_B0 %>%
  select(qv_sa_etat:qv_am_rac_pour_autre) %>%
  names()

M6_B1 <- M6_B0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    qv_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

```

# Retirer doublons

```{r M6_B1 to M6_C0}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons <- M6_B1 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(c("id_doublon", "id_keep"), .after = id_anonymat)

# Corriger les données d'identité issues du questionnaire

doublons_corr <- doublons %>%
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  ) %>% 
  filter(qv_complet == 1)

# Joindre les données propres
M6_C0 <- M6_B1 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat)

```

# Recoder les NAs

```{r}

rcd_simple_1 <- function(df, vars, complet){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ (case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 0 ~ -2,
          TRUE ~ -999
        ))
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_bin <- function(df, borne, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == 0 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_opt1 <- function(df, borne, x, out, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == x ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} %in% {{out}} ~ -1,
        )
      )
    )
}

```

```{r}

rcd_qcm_borne <- function(df, borne, vars){
  df %>%
    mutate(
      all_na_vars = if_all({{vars}}, is.na)
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ (case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          {{borne}} == 0 & all_na_vars ~ -1,
          {{borne}} == 1 & all_na_vars ~ -9,
          {{borne}} == -9 & all_na_vars ~ -9,
          {{borne}} == 1 & is.na(.x) ~ 0,
          TRUE ~ -999                           
        ))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-all_na_vars)
}
```


```{r M6_C0 to M6_C1}

quest_simples <- M6_C0 %>% 
  select(qv_sa_etat:qv_ad_besoin, qv_sc_travailleur:qv_am_regime,
         qv_am_complement, qv_am_ald:qv_am_rac) %>% 
  colnames()

QV5 <- M6_C0 %>% 
  select(qv_ad_act01:qv_ad_act999) %>% 
  colnames()

out_V7 <- c(2, 3)

QV18 <- M6_C0 %>% 
  select(qv_am_type_1:qv_am_type_999) %>% 
  colnames()

QV22 <- M6_C0 %>% 
  select(qv_am_rac_pour_1:qv_am_rac_pour_999) %>% 
  colnames()

M6_C1 <- M6_C0 %>% 
  rcd_simple_1(all_of(quest_simples), qv_complet) %>% 
  
  # Corriger à la main pcq option dans le questionnaire pour jsp et ne pas répondre
  # donc lui remettre notre codification
  mutate(
    qv_sa_etat = replace_when(
      qv_sa_etat,
      qv_sa_etat == 99 ~ -8,
      qv_sa_etat == 88 ~ -9
    )
  ) %>% 
  rcd_borne_bin(qv_ad_besoin, qv_ad_type) %>%
  rcd_borne_opt1(qv_ad_type, 1, out_V7, qv_ad_lien) %>% 
  rcd_qcm_borne(qv_ad_besoin, all_of(QV5)) %>% 
  rcd_qcm_borne(qv_am_complement, all_of(QV18)) %>% 
  mutate(
    qv_am_rac = replace_when(
      qv_am_rac,
      qv_am_rac == 0 & qv_am_rac_montant > 0 ~ 1
    )
  ) %>% 
  rcd_borne_bin(qv_am_rac, qv_am_rac_montant) %>% 
  rcd_qcm_borne(qv_am_rac, all_of(QV22))

rm(list = c("quest_simples", "QV18", "QV22", "QV5", "vars_check"))

```
